context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 10 adds 5 new service sub-pages and redesigned RideBookingPage. New pages: /beauty (12 services), /pet-care (12 services), /car-care (8 services), /towing (9 services), /more-taxi (10 services). RideBookingPage has 3 steps: 'plan' (form with favorite/recent locations), 'map' (Leaflet map + vehicle selection Basic/SUV/Luxe), 'searching' (driver search with OTP). Home page has new Towing section between Car Care and Buy/Sell/Rent. Login uses phone-first flow with FAB button - switch to email via 'Ou choisir d'autres options' modal then click 'Email' button.
